programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E4 - Lava's A Many Splendored Thing
programmes.d: The crew is on the way to rendezvous with Moya. After ingesting a concoction of Noranti's they stop for a break on a planet.
A quick turn of events sees Crichton chosen as the unwilling groom-to-be in the upcoming royal wedding.
Everyone finally reunites on Moya. But Aeryn returns with Scorpius, who claims to have saved the former Peacekeeper's life.
Someone removes Crichton's head from a statue; Aeryn examines her choices; Zhaan faces a Moya builder.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E6 - Natural Election
programmes.d: Crichton correctly predicts a wormhole's appearance near Moya, but simultaneously a giant space plant captures the Leviathan.
A crew member falls prey to a shape-shifting parasite and the rest of the crew must locate it before it is too late.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E7 - John Quixote
programmes.d: Crichton and Chiana get stuck in a video game where they encounter strange/twisted versions of their friends.
Crichton becomes a mental slave on a commerce planet and must trust his greatest enemy, Scorpius, to help him see the truth through the illusions.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E8 - I Shrink Therefore I Am
programmes.d: When Moya is raided by bounty hunters working for the Peacekeepers, every crew member is captured except for Crichton and Noranti.
The crew races to save Crichton after contact with a hyper stream of time speeds up his aging process.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E9 - A Prefect Murder
programmes.d: While Moya and her crew are resupplying on a generally xenophobic planet, Aeryn kills the next prefect while under a strange form of suggestion.
Talyn destroys a Plokavian ship, leading to the capture of the crew.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E10 - Coup By Clam
programmes.d: The crew consume food, sharing amongst themselves. Although if not ingested by the same person, it becomes toxic.
Chiana's unknowing part in the Nebari scheme to control a portion of the galaxy is revealed after they take over the Moya.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E11 - Unrealized Reality
programmes.d: Crichton falls into a wormhole and meets up with a strange man who shows Crichton the consequences of wormhole travel.
Stark plans to rob a less-than-reputable bank to get them money for a sizable purchase of slaves, but things don't quite go the way he thinks they will.
After accidentally returning to Earth, Crichton discovers he is in 1985 and he has altered the timeline.
Infected currency from the Shadow Depository threatens the crew of the Moya as they decide how best to rescue D'Argo's son.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E13 - Terra Firma
programmes.d: Crichton has arrived on Earth. Even though the Moya crew relaxes on Earth and are treated as VIPs, Crichton can't seem to adjust to life on Earth.
The crew of the injured Moya must rely on the help of disorganized mercenaries to save Crichton from Scorpius.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E14 - Twice Shy
programmes.d: Moya takes on a new passenger, Talikaa. However, Talikaa turns out to be an alien in disguise and is intent on harvesting the crew's neural energy.
An alien surgeon comes to the aid of Crichton, removing the control chip from his head and healing the Moya.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E15 - Mental As Anything
programmes.d: The males of the crew undergo some training. Crichton learns how to resist Scarran probes. While D'Argo learns some self-control.
The Moya's crew must quickly recover from their last adventure because Scorpius is up to his old tricks.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E16 - Bringing Home The Beacon
programmes.d: The women of Moya travel to a dead Leviathan to buy a sensor beacon for Moya which will allow her to appear to be a different ship.
An outrageous love triangle ignites dangerous sparks aboard a space station, where the crew find themselves trapped during a powerful interstellar storm.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E17 - A Constellation Of Doubt
programmes.d: John Crichton struggles to learn the location of the mysterious Katratzi, whilst watching a television documentary about himself and the aliens.
Crichton learns the elusive technology that could allow him to return home to Earth, but while he is preoccupied with the consequences a crew member unsuspectingly nears death.
Crichton and Scorpius travel to one of the 'unrealized realities' where Crichton believes he heard Stark say 'Katratzi.'
A crew member must volunteer to stay behind to guide the sabotaged ship, knowing that it will soon be atomized.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E19 - We're So Screwed, Part 1: Fetal Attraction
programmes.d: The crew goes after Aeryn on a Scarran controlled station.
Indulging in some high-tech sightseeing at the site of a major historical event, Crichton and his friends are sucked through a time rift and find themselves in the middle of a key battle.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E20 - We're So Screwed, Part 2: Hot To Katratzi
programmes.d: Moya arrives at Katratzi. Crichton attends the peace talks between the Scarrans and the Peacekeepers with a nuclear bomb.
A brain-sucking alien and a pack of crazed Xarai threaten D'Argo, Chiana and Jool.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E21 - We're So Screwed, Part 3: La Bomba
programmes.d: Scorpius has betrayed the crew. Now they're all captured. Their plan failed, the crew has little choice but to help Scorpius's true agenda.
Traveling to a warring planet to obtain medicine for Talyn, who was injured in a skirmish with a Peacekeeper Retrieval Squad.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S4 E22 - Bad Timing
programmes.d: With their Crystherium stores low, the Scarrans must travel to Earth through a wormhole as those flowers grow there.

Talyn gets swallowed by a Budong, and it is up to Stark to save them; Crichton, already distrustful of Crais, believes he and Aeryn are having an affair while Talyn himself soon shows his hatred of the human.
John Crichton and Aeryn anticipate the birth of their child, only to get caught in the middle of a war that threatens millions of lives.
Parasitic Energy Riders hitch a ride on Moya, planning to plant themselves inside the bodies of the crew.
The Peacekeeper Retrieval Squad finally reveals its true mission when it confronts Crichton and his crew.
Determined not to let his child be born into a world at war, John Crichton puts himself at the center of the conflict.
Scorpius (Wayne Pygram) risks it all when appealing to Crichton (Ben Browder) for an alliance by revealing his shrouded past.
Crichton's ship suddenly begins flying toward the sun and he, along with crewmates Aeryn and Crais, battles to override its compulsion.
Astronaut John Crichton attempts to propel his module at high speeds but is hit by a radiation wave and is sucked through a wormhole.
Crichton and his crew take a cruise on a "pleasure planet," but it turns out to be more of a pain than they bargained for.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E2 - Exodus From Genesis
programmes.d: A locator beacon, automatically broadcasting its exact location to any Peacekeeper forces in the area.
A dangerous species unlocks the long-held secrets to wormhole technology, unleashing the fury of the Ancients.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E3 - Back And Back And Back To The Future
programmes.d: The crew rescues a scientist and his assistant from a disintegrating ship.
Crichton and Aeryn race to construct the ultimate weapon in order to survive an attack by the Scarrans.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E4 - Throne For A Loss
programmes.d: Rygel is captured and held for ransom by some bounty hunters.
A strange ship bent on self-destruction targets Moya and with Crichton in a coma, D'Argo has to save the day.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E5 - PK Tech Girl
programmes.d: After finding the legendary Peacekeeper battleship, Zelbinion, dead in space Crichton, Aeryn, and D'Argo find a Peacekeeper tech under Crais's command.
Aeryn yearns to contact her father when the crew lands on a planet laden with mystics, seers and also frauds.
